business.name: Ledgerline Bookkeeping (example)
business.what_we_sell: bookkeeping, payroll and year-end accounts for small UK businesses
business.ideal_buyer: an owner, founder or manager of a small UK business (1 to 50 staff) asking for a bookkeeper, an accountant or help with their books, payroll, VAT or year-end, for their own business
business.not_a_fit: bookkeepers or accountants advertising their own services, job seekers, recruiters filling an in-house role, students, software vendors

tabs.name: Hot
tabs.means: a business asking for bookkeeping, payroll, VAT or accounts help for itself, right now

tabs.name: Prospect
tabs.means: a person from the people search who fits the ideal buyer (owner or finance lead at a small UK business)

tabs.name: Partner
tabs.means: an accounting firm looking to hand work to a subcontractor or white-label bookkeeper

judge_notes: A post that needs the provider on-site somewhere outside the UK goes to Excluded. A recruiter hiring an in-house bookkeeper for a client is not a lead. A people-search result is a Prospect only when their headline or company fits the ideal buyer.

reject.pattern: \b(?:we offer|our services include|dm me for|book a free (?:call|consultation) with (?:me|us))\b

review.why: may want software, not a service
